battle.name: 內沙布兒之戰
battle.brief: 一二二一年春，蒙古第一次西征平定呼羅珊的攻城戰：大軍攻破木鹿與阿拉木忒後轉入呼羅珊平原，圍困內沙布兒，砲車晝夜轟擊城牆；守軍以弩陣與出城反擊抵禦，終因一段城牆被轟塌而失守。卡面歐洲式十字弩約一一〇〇年定型，同期已是歐洲制式攻城與守城武器，與本役守方所用之弩同出歐亞弩類技術譜系。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 內沙布兒之戰是蒙古第一次西征在呼羅珊平原的攻城戰，交戰的兩套系統都是崩解中的國家。蒙古一方由大汗成吉思汗本部中軍主導，配屬哲別與速不台等部將率領的追擊分隊，以及一支專責攻城的器械隊：攻城技師多為前一年玉龍傑赤城下擄獲的漢人、回回工匠與被征服的花剌子模工匠，隨軍操作砲車、雲梯與填壕器械；騎兵為主力，每名射手隨身帶著數匹備用馬，靠馬馱隊輸送給養。花剌子模一方則是崩解中的國家軍殘部：花剌子模沙札剌勒丁・曼格伯爾尼在帕爾萬戰敗後退往印度河方向，留守呼羅珊的守軍由總督胡瓦傑・希茲爾與該城教法師慕賈希德・丁分掌城防與民政，下轄依附花剌子模的呼羅珊部眾與城內民兵。蒙古的指揮重心只有大汗營帳一座，攻城由各部按次撥營，器械隊隨主力移動；花剌子模方面以城防為核心，援軍自木鹿、哈馬丹方向斷續北上，卻因阿拉木忒與布魯特相繼失守而無從成軍。兩方的差距不只在兵力，更在攻城器械與騎兵機動的組織方式。
countriesEn: The battle of Nishapur was a siege fought on the plain of Khorasan during the Mongol western campaign, and both of the systems that collided there were states in the process of coming apart. On the Mongol side the command sat in a single place, the great khan's central camp at the head of the main body, with detachments under Jebe and Subutai hunting the defeated Khwarazmian field army elsewhere, and with a dedicated siege train attached to the army. The engineers who ran that train were in large part Chinese, Muslim and Khwarazmian craftsmen taken at Urgench the year before, and it was they who worked the mangonels, the scaling ladders and the earth and rubble used to fill the ditch. The army was cavalry in its core, every archer carrying several spare horses and the food and fodder travelling by pack train. The Khwarazmian side was the residue of a collapsing state: the sultan Jalal al-Din Mangburni had been defeated at Parwan and was withdrawing toward the Indus, and the garrison left in Khorasan was held together by the governor Khwaja Khizr and the qadi of the city Mujahid al-Din, who between them commanded the defences and the civil administration, with the local tribes attached to Khwarazm and the armed townsmen under them. The Mongol chain of command had one centre and no more, so siege operations were allotted out of each tribal division in turn and the siege train simply followed the main body; the Khwarazmian system was centred on the walls, with relieving forces trickling north from Merv and Hamadan, unable to assemble into anything because Alamut and the Parwan plain had already fallen. The gap between the two sides was therefore not a matter of numbers alone, but of how siege artillery and cavalry mobility were organised.
people: 成吉思汗是這一役的實際指揮者。他在帕爾萬追擊札剌勒丁・曼格伯爾尼失利之後折回呼羅珊，決定以逐城攻取的方式把蒙古軍從掠奪性的遠征改為佔領與徵稅；內沙布兒的圍城正落在這個轉折點上。哲別與速不台率輕騎往印度河方向追擊花剌子模餘部，那支追兵不在內沙布兒城下，察合台等諸子各領一翼作戰。木鹿總督與阿拉木忒的守將相繼被殺或降，說明這個帝國能組織抵抗的中心已經散落，只剩各城孤軍死守。花剌子模方面的關鍵人物是內沙布兒總督胡瓦傑・希茲爾與該城教法師慕賈希德・丁：前者主持城防、調度出城反擊與器械部署，後者維持城內的秩序，在最後階段率眾抵抗並成為蒙古軍清算城防的對象之一。攻城結束後被蒙古軍擄走的木匠、鐵匠、器械匠與熟手，也是這場戰役裡被雙方爭取的「人」；他們遠比城牆更有價值，日後被押往蒙古本部與怯薛營隊，把攻城技術帶過了整個歐亞草原。
peopleEn: Genghis Khan was the man actually directing this operation. After the pursuit of Jalal al-Din Mangburni stalled at Parwan he turned his army back into Khorasan and resolved to take the cities one by one, converting the western campaign from a raid into an occupation and a tax system; the siege of Nishapur falls exactly at that turning point. Jebe and Subutai led light cavalry after the Khwarazmian remnants toward the Indus and were not at Nishapur at all, while Chagatai and the other sons of the khan commanded separate wings. The governor of Merv and the garrison commanders of Alamut were killed or surrendered in turn, which shows that the organised centres of resistance in the empire had been broken up, leaving isolated garrisons to hold cities one at a time. On the Khwarazmian side the decisive figures were the governor of Nishapur, Khwaja Khizr, and the qadi of the city, Mujahid al-Din: the first directed the defences, arranged the sorties and positioned the artillery of the walls, the second kept order inside the town and led the resistance in the final phase, becoming one of the men the Mongols settled with when they closed the account on the defence. The craftsmen seized at the end of the siege - carpenters, smiths, engineers and their assistants - were the people both sides fought over in this campaign; they were worth far more to the Mongols than the walls were, and were carried off to the Mongol homeland and the keshik, taking siegecraft across the Eurasian steppe with them.
kits: 卡面武器是約一一〇〇年前後定型、十二世紀在英格蘭與歐洲軍隊中普及的十字弩：木製弩身前端為複合弓臂，張力由鐵製部件承受，弦用絞盤上緊，扳機待發，備用弩矢收在木匣內隨射手攜帶。英格蘭一一八一年的《武備條例》已明文要求弩手自備弩具與弩矢，說明到本役年代，這種弩在歐洲已是制式化的攻城與守城武器，與卡面年份相合。在呼羅珊防線上，蒙古軍與花剌子模軍所用的複合弩同屬這一技術家族：弓臂用角、木與腱複合，張力大、箭矢平直，穿鎧能力高於弓，但裝填慢，一發之後必須重新上弦；守城時可以預先上弦、列於城垛缺口後齊射，野戰中裝填的間隙足以讓騎兵衝到近前。除弩之外，本役真正左右勝負的是蒙古軍的砲車，中型配重式投石車所發石彈重數十至百餘公斤，專門用來砸開夯土與磚石混合的城牆；蒙古軍另備雲梯、長梯與填壕用的土石，騎兵每人數匹備馬以換乘延續追擊。花剌子模守軍則以弓、標槍、長矛與牆頭的弩列陣，鎧甲、弓弦與攻城器械都來自已經被耗盡的國家工坊。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a crossbow of a type settled in its essentials around the year 1100 and in regular service in English and European armies through the twelfth century: a wooden stock carrying a composite bow at the front, the tension carried by iron fittings, the string wound up with a windlass, the trigger holding the bolt, and the spare bolts carried in a wooden case that went with the archer. The Assize of Arms of 1181 in England already required crossbowmen to provide their own bows and bolts, which shows that by the year of this battle such a weapon was standard issue for siege and wall duty in Europe, matching the year on the card. On the Khorasan front the composite crossbows used by the Mongols and by the Khwarazmians belonged to the same technical family: the bow was built up from horn, wood and sinew, its tension was high, the bolt flew flat, and it pierced armour better than a bow, but reloading was slow and after a single shot the weapon had to be cranked again. On a wall it could be kept loaded and fired in volleys from behind the crenellations; in the open field the interval needed to reload was long enough for cavalry to reach contact. But the crossbow was not what decided this battle. The Mongols' mangonels were: the counterweighted stone-throwers of medium size sent stones weighing from several tens to more than a hundred kilograms, and their only purpose was to break walls built of rammed earth and brick. The besiegers also brought scaling ladders, long poles and earth and rubble for filling the ditch, while every horseman carried several spare mounts to sustain the pursuit through relay riding. The Khwarazmian garrison, for its part, was arrayed with bows, javelins, spears and rows of crossbows along the wall, and its armour, bowstrings and siege plant all came from state workshops that had already been emptied.
tactics: 蒙古軍先以數個騎兵隊封鎖城郊道路，切斷內沙布兒同木鹿、哈馬丹方向的聯繫，再把主力安營在攻城器械能支援的距離內。呼羅珊平原缺乏山地屏障，蒙古軍得以把砲車隊直接拉進城下：先以土石填平壕溝，把砲車推上接近城牆的位置，晝夜轟擊。守軍依牆段分區死守，同時不斷出城反擊；史籍記載蒙古軍在反擊中佗敗誘敵，把出城的守軍拉離城門後回身掩殺，再以弩陣與標槍封住回城道路，逼守軍縮回牆內。砲擊最終壓垮一段城牆，缺口被清理成可通行的通道，蒙古軍以雲梯與長梯在缺口內側同時登城，入城後逐街清剿殘部，奪取城內工坊與器械。整個過程說明一件事：弩在守方手裡是把慢速而精確的武器，在攻方手裡卻只是掩護；真正決定圍城長短的是砲與壕溝，而不是任何一具弩機。
tacticsEn: The Mongols first sealed the roads around the city with several mounted detachments, cutting Nishapur off from Merv and Hamadan, and then pitched the main body close enough for the siege train to be supported. The plain of Khorasan offers no mountain barrier, so the Mongols were able to bring the mangonel train straight up to the walls: first filling the ditch with earth and rubble, then pushing the stone-throwers to positions close enough to the wall and hammering away day and night. The defenders held the circuit section by section and kept sallying out; the chronicles record the Mongols feigning flight during one of these sorties, drawing the sortieing garrison away from the gates before turning back on it, and then sealing the road back to the town with crossbow volleys and javelins so that the defenders were driven back inside the walls. The bombardment eventually brought down a section of the wall, the breach was cleared into a passage, and the Mongols went up on scaling ladders and long ladders together inside the gap, then worked through the streets street by street to clear the remaining resistance and took possession of the workshops and weapons inside the town. The whole operation illustrates one thing: in the hands of the defenders a crossbow was a slow but accurate weapon, in the hands of the attackers it was only a covering fire, and what really determined how long the siege ran was the stone-throwers and the ditch, not any individual crossbow.
data: 可核的數字有限，只能給出量級與範圍。一二二一年這條戰線上，蒙古遠征軍的總兵力通常被估為十萬上下，呼羅珊方向的一路為數萬騎；每名射手配二至三匹馬，一個騎兵分隊在平原上一天的推進距離約三十至五十公里，糧秣與備用馬靠馬馱隊維持。花剌子模帝國在帕爾萬、阿拉木忒與布魯特連失三役之後，能調集的野戰兵力所剩無幾，內沙布兒守軍的規模史籍沒有留下可信數目，只能確定其成分是花剌子模國家軍殘部與城內民兵。器械方面可對照的數字是：中型砲車的石彈重數十至百餘公斤；弩的有效射程約一百五十至二百公尺，弩矢能穿透鎧甲的距離要短得多；弩匣通常只裝數十支弩矢，射擊因此是短促的齊射而非連續火力，一個射手一分鐘之內頂多再射一至兩次。圍城的日數各家記載不一，較常見的說法落在十餘日至數十日之間；陷城之後的殺傷數字在中世紀記錄裡明顯誇大，本卡不予採錄，只取可以確定的部分：城防崩潰、守軍覆沒、器械與工坊被毀、技術人員被擄。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, so only magnitudes and ranges are given. On this front in 1221 the Mongol western expedition is usually estimated at around a hundred thousand men in total, with the force operating in Khorasan numbering some tens of thousands of riders; each archer carried two or three horses, a mounted detachment could cover thirty to fifty kilometres of plain in a day, and fodder and spare horses travelled by pack train. After the losses at Parwan, Alamut and the Parwan plain, the Khwarazmian Empire could no longer muster field forces worth the name, and no credible figure for the size of the Nishapur garrison survives, only the certainty that it consisted of the remnants of the Khwarazmian state army together with the armed townsmen. On the equipment side the figures that can be compared are these: the stones of a medium-sized mangonel weighed from several tens to more than a hundred kilograms; the effective range of a crossbow was roughly a hundred and fifty to two hundred metres, and the distance at which a bolt would pierce armour was markedly shorter; a bolt case normally held only a few dozen bolts, so shooting came in short volleys rather than as a stream of fire, and a single archer could not release more than one or two bolts a minute. The length of the siege is reported differently by different sources, the most common account placing it somewhere between a dozen-odd days and several tens of days; the casualty figures given for the fall of the city are plainly exaggerated in the medieval manner and are not used here, and only the certain parts are kept: the defences collapsed, the garrison was overwhelmed, the artillery and workshops were destroyed, and skilled craftsmen were carried off.
cause: 導火線遠在內沙布兒的城牆之外。十二世紀初，花剌子模沙摩澤及其子札剌勒丁在東方與西亞的權勢伸張，同西遼殘部、乃蠻、突騎施等勢力衝突不斷；一一一九年秋，成吉思汗派出的商隊在奧特拉爾遇害，花剌子模又處置蒙古使團，兩國之間的商道往來隨之中斷。成吉思汗要求花剌子模歸順並懲辦兇手，得不到答覆後，於一二一九年秋分兵西征，兵分三路，主力取布哈拉、撒馬爾罕與花剌子模等中亞城邑，於一二二○年初進入呼羅珊，逐城攻破布哈拉、撒馬爾罕、不花剌與玉龍傑赤，再進軍木鹿、阿拉木忒。內沙布兒這場攻城是遠征的收尾一段：札剌勒丁在帕爾萬戰敗、退入印度河之後，蒙古軍必須剷除呼羅珊各城的抵抗，才能把這片平原變成穩定的後方與稅源；內沙布兒扼守呼羅珊北上的大道，又控制著木鹿方向與阿爾達什爾河谷的銜接點，不拿下它，蒙古軍的騎兵就無法安心縱深機動。長期糾纏的使團與商道糾葛，也讓雙方都沒有退路可退。
causeEn: The trigger lay far outside the walls of Nishapur. At the opening of the twelfth century the Khwarazmian ruler Mu'izz al-Din and his son Jalal al-Din extended their power eastward and westward, colliding repeatedly with the remnants of the Qara Khitai, the Naimans and the Turgesh; in the autumn of 1219 a Mongol caravan was destroyed at Otrar, and the Khwarazmians then detained a Mongol embassy, which cut the trade between the two states. Genghis Khan demanded that Khwarazm submit and that the guilty be punished, received no answer, and in the autumn of 1219 divided his army for the western campaign, marching in three columns; the main body took Bukhara, Samarkand and the cities of Transoxiana, entered Khorasan in early 1220 and struck city after city - Bukhara, Samarkand, Bukhara-side Urgench, then Merv and Alamut. The siege of Nishapur belongs to the closing stage of that campaign. With Jalal al-Din defeated at Parwan and withdrawing toward the Indus, the Mongols had to root out the resistance of the Khorasan cities before the plain could be turned into a settled rear area and a source of revenue. Nishapur commanded the road north through Khorasan and the junction with the valley of the Ardashir and Merv; until it was taken, Mongol cavalry could not ride deep into the interior with any confidence. The long entanglement of embassies and caravan routes had also left neither side a way out.
impact: 內沙布兒陷落，標誌着花剌子模帝國在呼羅珊的抵抗全面崩解，也把蒙古第一次西征從掠奪性的遠征改造成永久佔領。城破之後被送往蒙古本部的工匠，是這次遠征最耐用的戰果：他們帶走木匠、鐵匠與器械匠的技藝，蒙古軍此後的攻城能力明顯高於西征初期，一二二一年攻阿拉木忒、一二三一年攻河南與潼關、一二三五年攻襄樊時所見的砲與攻城器械，都建立在這批被擄技術者之上。經濟上，呼羅珊的綠松石、絲綢與駱駝商路轉入蒙古的稅收體系，蒙古人在城址上重建城邑，並徵用波斯人充任書吏、稅吏與工匠首領，日後札兀兒人治下呼羅珊的城市網絡與稅制，正建立在這一轉折點上。對整個伊朗高原而言，一二二一年是分期點：舊的花剌子模王朝崩解，蒙古人的征服時代由此鋪開，之後數百年的兵役、稅斂與城市重建，都從呼羅珊這座城開始算起。
impactEn: The fall of Nishapur marked the complete collapse of Khwarazmian resistance in Khorasan and turned the first Mongol western campaign from a raid into a permanent occupation. The craftsmen sent back to the Mongol homeland after the city fell were the most durable result of the expedition: they carried with them the skills of carpenters, smiths and engineers, and the siege capability of the Mongol army from that point on was visibly greater than it had been at the start of the campaign. The mangonels and siege works seen at Alamut in 1221, in Henan and at Tong Pass in 1231, and before Xiangyang in 1235 all rest on the labour of those captured artisans. Economically, the trade in turquoise, silk and camels that crossed Khorasan was folded into the Mongol tax system; the Mongols rebuilt the city on the old site and took Persian scribes, tax collectors and foremen of the workshops into service, and the network of cities and taxation in Khorasan under the Ilkhanate rests on that turning point. For the whole Iranian plateau, 1221 is a dividing line: the old Khwarazmian dynasty is gone, the age of the Mongol conquest opens, and the centuries of service, taxation and urban rebuilding that follow are counted from the taking of this city in Khorasan.
result: 結果是城破。蒙古軍在砲火與登城之後控制全城，守軍與城內武裝被解除武裝，主持抵抗的胡瓦傑・希茲爾在城陷時身亡，城的城牆被拆毀或降為平地，城內的工坊、儲備與器械被清點，一批技術人員被押往蒙古本部。這場勝利直接換來的是呼羅珊平原的開闊：蒙古軍隨後肅清赫拉特、加茲尼一線的花剌子模據點，把呼羅珊同河中、中亞的後方連成一條線；札剌勒丁・曼格伯爾尼則繼續沿印度河逃往德里方向，在印度河下游的戰役之後退入印度東北，此後再未回到呼羅珊。對蒙古自身而言，此役之後西征再無退路：遠征軍於一二二一年冬經呼羅珊北返，帶走的除了工匠之外，還有對伊朗城市、關稅與技術的一次徹底勘察。對這座城而言，代價則是延續數代的城邑重建、稅制改變與工匠西遷，直到後來者再以自己的方式把它重新寫進亞洲的城鎮網絡之中。
resultEn: The result was that the city fell. After the stone-throwers and the escalade the Mongols held the whole place; the garrison and the armed townsmen were disarmed, Khwaja Khizr, who had directed the resistance, was killed as the city was taken, the walls were pulled down or levelled, the workshops, stores and artillery inside were counted and inventoried, and a body of craftsmen was driven off to the Mongol homeland. What the victory bought directly was the opening up of the plain of Khorasan: the Mongols then cleared the remaining Khwarazmian strongholds along the Herat and Ghazni line, linking Khorasan with Transoxiana and the central Asian rear in one continuous arc, while Jalal al-Din Mangburni kept fleeing east along the Indus, was beaten again in the fighting downstream and withdrew into north-eastern India, never returning to Khorasan. For the Mongols themselves the campaign was finished at that point and could no longer be turned back: the expedition returned north through Khorasan in the winter of 1221, taking with it craftsmen, and with them a thorough reconnaissance of the cities, the tolls and the techniques of Iran. For the city itself the price was a rebuilding that ran through several generations, a change in the tax regime and the removal of its craftsmen to the west, until later masters wrote it back into the network of Asian towns in their own fashion.
